clauses.name: Definition of Confidential Information
clauses.description: What information is considered confidential under this agreement

high: Extremely broad definition covering virtually any information
medium: Broad definition but limited to business-related information
low: Clearly defined categories with specific examples

clauses.name: Exclusions from Confidentiality
clauses.description: What information is NOT considered confidential

high: Missing standard exclusions (public knowledge, prior possession)
medium: Exclusions exist but are narrowly defined
low: Standard exclusions: publicly available, independently developed, prior knowledge, third-party disclosure

clauses.name: Obligations of Receiving Party
clauses.description: What the receiving party must do to protect confidential information

high: Absolute liability for any disclosure regardless of fault
Must destroy all copies with no retention right
low: Reasonable care standard, similar to own confidential information

clauses.name: Term and Duration
clauses.description: How long the NDA and confidentiality obligations last

low: Reasonable duration (1-3 years) with clear start and end

clauses.name: Return or Destruction of Information
clauses.description: What happens to confidential information when the NDA ends

high: Must certify destruction of all copies including backups
medium: Return required but no timeline specified
low: Clear return/destruction process with reasonable timeline

clauses.name: Permitted Disclosures
clauses.description: When and to whom confidential information can be shared

high: No permitted disclosures, even to own legal counsel
No carve-out for legally compelled disclosure
medium: Limited permitted disclosures, must notify disclosing party first
low: Reasonable permitted disclosures including legal counsel, advisors, and legally compelled disclosures

high: Automatic injunctive relief without court process
medium: Injunctive relief acknowledged as appropriate remedy
low: Standard remedies including injunctive relief and damages as determined by court

clauses.name: Non-Solicitation
clauses.description: Whether the NDA includes restrictions on soliciting employees or customers

high: Broad non-solicitation bundled into an NDA without separate consideration
Covers any employee or customer contact
medium: Non-solicitation limited to key contacts for reasonable period
low: No non-solicitation clause, or very narrowly scoped

clauses.name: Governing Law
clauses.description: Which jurisdiction's laws govern the agreement

high: Governing law is a distant or unfamiliar jurisdiction
low: Governing law is the receiving party's home jurisdiction or mutually convenient
